renderMethod.parser: Exact packaged Spine3.8.99 binary/atlas/material texture links; compatible static parser @pixi-spine/runtime-3.8@4.0.6
renderMethod.raster: New segments240px CPU bilinear textured triangles, normal/multiply blend, default skin; atlas declared size normalization; source slot/attachment colors
renderMethod.time: New segments sample8Hz including endpoint, maximum2source seconds per file; GIF cumulative10ms time quantization and10ms final-pose hold. Existing15 representative samples retain their original320px/12Hz transforms.
renderMethod.comparison: Each segment independently loops and fits its own source bounds. Switching segments is a comparison UI, not a seamless original animation transition.
renderMethod.omitted: Original Unity shader/masks/camera/world layering, C# map trigger/state machine, voiced dialogue/SFX and device/frame timing

boundaries: 동봉 스켈레톤에서 계산한 기술 재현이며 원작 실행·촬영이 아닙니다.
선정 source-time 구간은 이 클립의 선언시간0부터 끝까지 연속 범위를 덮지만 모든 원작 프레임을 보거나 네이티브 렌더와 일치한다고 확인한 결과는 아닙니다.
